g.text: VOLUME POT: J2 pins 2=GND, 3=wiper, 4=3V3. Use 10k linear.

g.desc: VOLUME POT: J2 pins 2=GND, 3=wiper, 4=3V3. Use 10k linear.

g.text: R39/R40 scale full travel to ~2.27V; C58 filters ADC noise.

g.desc: R39/R40 scale full travel to ~2.27V; C58 filters ADC noise.

g.text: GPIO34 = ADC1_CH6. Firmware: highest ADC attenuation, average readings;

g.desc: GPIO34 = ADC1_CH6. Firmware: highest ADC attenuation, average readings;

g.text: calibrate endpoints / taper and map low or disconnected wiper to mute.

g.desc: calibrate endpoints / taper and map low or disconnected wiper to mute.

g.text: Preserved: LED Wi-Fi=32, BT=33; LRCK=25, BCK=26, DIN=13; SCL=19, SDA=21.

g.desc: Preserved: LED Wi-Fi=32, BT=33; LRCK=25, BCK=26, DIN=13; SCL=19, SDA=21.

g.text: Added: SDZ enable=27; MUTE command=23 (HIGH=mute); FAULTZ=35 (input only); DAC_XSMT=18.

g.desc: Added: SDZ enable=27; MUTE command=23 (HIGH=mute); FAULTZ=35 (input only); DAC_XSMT=18.

g.text: GPIO36 ADC1 monitors PVDD/11. Volume pot: GPIO34 / ADC1_CH6 (module pin 6). GPIO0 BOOT pull-up; EN reset has 10k/1u RC.

g.desc: GPIO36 ADC1 monitors PVDD/11. Volume pot: GPIO34 / ADC1_CH6 (module pin 6). GPIO0 BOOT pull-up; EN reset has 10k/1u RC.

g.text: GPIO6-11 / GPIO16-17 reserved for internal flash/PSRAM: no external use.

g.desc: GPIO6-11 / GPIO16-17 reserved for internal flash/PSRAM: no external use.

g.text: J2 system: 2=GND, 3=volume wiper, 4=3V3. Suggested pot: 10k linear.

g.desc: J2 system: 2=GND, 3=volume wiper, 4=3V3. Suggested pot: 10k linear.

g.text: J3 is the separate programming header; use 3.3 V UART logic.

g.desc: J3 is the separate programming header; use 3.3 V UART logic.

g.text: Module custom pads 39-47 are segments of the common exposed GND area.

g.desc: Module custom pads 39-47 are segments of the common exposed GND area.

g.text: Fit a compatible external antenna to the IE module; keep RF connector/feed away from switch nodes.

g.desc: Fit a compatible external antenna to the IE module; keep RF connector/feed away from switch nodes.
